class.name: GameCenter
class.brief_description: Apple's Game Center on macOS, iOS and tvOS.
class.description: Signs the player in to Game Center, reports achievements and leaderboard scores, lists the player's friends, and handles invites and parties. Real-time matches are [GameCenterMultiplayerPeer]'s. Most games use [Purr], which uses this on Apple platforms; it's here for anything [Purr] doesn't cover. Exported games need a bundle ID set up for Game Center in App Store Connect, and Entitlements > Game Center ticked in the export preset. Each call returns a signal that fires once with a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]error[/code]. [codeblock] var signed_in = await GameCenter.authenticate() if signed_in.ok: GameCenter.report_achievement("first_steps") [/codeblock]

method.name: authenticate
method.description: Signs the player in to Game Center, showing Apple's sign-in screen if needed. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]error[/code], plus [code]player_name[/code].

method.name: end_party
method.description: Ends the party [method start_party] started, if any.

method.name: fetch_identity_verification
method.description: Asks Game Center for a signature proving who the player is, for a server to check. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]error[/code], plus [code]public_key_url[/code], [code]signature[/code] and [code]salt[/code] (base64), [code]timestamp[/code], [code]team_player_id[/code] and [code]bundle_id[/code]: what [method PurrOnline.sign_in_game_center] takes.

method.name: get_achievements
method.description: Loads the player's achievements. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code], [code]error[/code] and [code]achievements[/code], [code]{id: percent}[/code] for every achievement the player has made progress on.

method.name: get_player_name
method.description: Returns the signed-in player's name, or empty.

method.name: get_scores
method.description: Loads up to [param count] all-time scores (100 at most), as [param scope] says ([constant SCOPE_FRIENDS] asks the player to share their friends list the first time). Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]scores[/code], each with [code]rank[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]score[/code] and [code]player[/code].

method.name: get_team_player_id
method.description: Returns the signed-in player's identifier, the same in all of the developer team's games, or empty.

method.name: invite_friend
method.description: Invites one friend (an [code]id[/code] from [method load_friends]) without Apple's invite screen, to the crossplay lobby in [param player_group], like [method invite_players]. Purr's [method Friends.invite] calls it.

method.name: invite_players
method.description: Opens Game Center's invite screen, for up to [param max_players] players. An invited player who accepts gets [signal invite_accepted] with the same [param player_group], a number the game uses to say what to join. The screen closes once someone accepts.

method.name: is_authenticated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player is signed in to Game Center.

method.name: load_friends
method.description: The player's Game Center friends. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and [code]friends[/code], an [Array] of [Dictionary] with [code]id[/code] (their gamePlayerID), [code]team_player_id[/code] (their teamPlayerID, which the online services know players by) and [code]name[/code]. The first time, Game Center asks the player whether to share their friends with the game; on iOS, tvOS and visionOS, Purr's exports give the reason it shows ([code]NSGKFriendListUsageDescription[/code]), and on macOS a game that uses friends adds it to the export preset's [code]application/additional_plist_content[/code]. Purr's [method Friends.get_all] calls it.

method.name: report_achievement
method.description: Reports progress on an achievement, [param percent] from [code]0[/code] to [code]100[/code] (unlocked at [code]100[/code]), showing Game Center's banner. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]error[/code].

method.name: show_achievements
method.description: Opens Game Center's achievements screen over the game.

method.name: show_leaderboard
method.description: Opens Game Center's screen for a leaderboard, or for all the game's leaderboards when [param leaderboard_id] is empty.

method.name: start_party
method.description: Starts the game activity [param activity_id] (from App Store Connect, with party codes turned on) with this party code, two halves of 2 to 6 characters joined by a dash. Friends see the party in Apple's Games app; joining it gives their game [signal party_joined]. Needs iOS, macOS, tvOS or visionOS 26 or later; earlier, it does nothing.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits a score to a leaderboard. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]error[/code].

signal.name: invite_accepted
signal.description: Emitted when the player accepted an invite from [method invite_players], with the inviter's [param player_group].

signal.name: match_invite_accepted
signal.description: Emitted when the player accepted an invite to another player's Game Center match (one without a player group), from [param sender_id]. [method GameCenterMultiplayerPeer.accept_invite] takes the match. Purr joins it as a lobby by itself.

signal.name: party_joined
signal.description: Emitted when the player chose to join a party (see [method start_party]) in Apple's Games app.

constants.constant: The best among the player's friends.
Those around the player's own, or the best if they have none.
